verdict.rationale: Bugbot lets teams encode their own review guidelines in `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` files, and admins can add organization-wide rules through Bugbot Automations. A verbose mode shows which rules were loaded for each review, which helps confirm they are being applied. Missing for 10: AST/structural pattern rules, support for linking external style guides, detailed rule-format documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration that custom rules are reliably enforced.
